title_ar: حكم التنفل يوم العيد قبل الصلاة
title_en: The ruling on voluntary prayer on the day of Eid before the prayer
body_ar:
ما حكم التنفل في المصلى يوم العيد قبل الصلاة خارج المسجد؟

أن النبي (ص) في ذهابه إلى المصلى لم يصل قبل الصلاة شيئا ولا بعدها شيئا كما ثبت ذلك عنه في الصحيح، فلم يصل قبل صلاة العيد شيئا ولم يصل بعدها شيئا فالمصلى نافلته هي صلاة العيد فتصلى فيه تلك الصلاة وينصرف الناس بعدها، فإذا كان عيد الأضحى فإن بعد الصلاة شغلا وهو نسك ذلك اليوم بالضحية، وإن كانت صلاة يوم الفطر فإن قبلها نسكا وهو إخراج زكاة الفطر.
body_en:
What is the ruling on performing voluntary prayer (nāfilah) at the prayer ground on the day of Eid, before the prayer, outside the mosque?

The Prophet, upon whom be peace, when he went out to the prayer ground, prayed nothing before the prayer and nothing after it, as is established from him in the Ṣaḥīḥ. He prayed nothing before the Eid prayer and nothing after it. The prayer ground's voluntary act is the Eid prayer itself: that prayer is performed there, and the people disperse afterwards. If it is Eid al-Adha, then after the prayer there is something to occupy one, namely the rite (nusuk) of that day, the sacrifice; and if it is the prayer of the day of Fitr, then before it there is a rite, namely the giving of zakat al-fitr.

flags.arabic: كما ثبت ذلك عنه في الصحيح
flags.context: the Sheikh's attribution for the report that the Prophet prayed nothing before or after the Eid prayer
options: as is established from him in the Ṣaḥīḥ
as is established from him in the two Ṣaḥīḥs (al-Bukhari and Muslim)
as is established from him in a sound report
flags.note: The Sheikh says only 'in al-Ṣaḥīḥ', without naming the collection. The report (Ibn ʿAbbas) is in fact in both al-Bukhari and Muslim, but the style guide forbids supplying an attribution he did not give, so option 0 keeps his wording. A reviewer may prefer to add the collection in a footnote rather than in the body.

In the source, the answer begins with the elliptical particle 'anna ('[the answer is] that ...'), the Joomla fatwa template's standing form. The English drops the particle and begins the sentence directly; no content is added or removed by this.

The date shown by the CMS (27 December 2010) is a bulk-upload timestamp shared by every item in this range, not the date the Sheikh gave the answer. The real date of composition is unknown. See date_is_cms_bulk_upload.

'The prayer ground's voluntary act is the Eid prayer itself' renders 'fa-l-muṣallā nāfilatuhu hiya ṣalāt al-ʿīd' — i.e. at the prayer ground the Eid prayer occupies the place that a voluntary prayer would otherwise occupy. The Arabic is compressed and the English has been opened out only as far as grammar requires.
